to_work.title_display: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

work_relations.note: The performance capture technology perfected by Weta Digital for the character of Gollum was a foundational technique expanded upon for the Na'vi in 'Avatar', setting a new standard for digitally-created, emotionally resonant characters.

Avatar's central conflict of an industrial/military human force exploiting a planet's natural resources against the will of its spiritually connected, nature-defending inhabitants is thematically and visually indebted to Princess Mononoke.

to_work.title_display: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

work_relations.note: Critics noted strong thematic and visual similarities, including a protagonist who bridges the gap between an industrial-military force and a native population living in harmony with a sacred, interconnected ecosystem. The glowing forest of Pandora echoes Nausicaä's purified cavern.
